messages:
Mike (PR): Heads-up — planning a small analyst + press briefing for the Benchmark post next Wed. Need embargo logistics, final quote, and a short one-pager. Who can own what?
Sara (Comms): I can own the invite list + press checklist. Will need the quote by EOD Mon.
Jin (Product): Happy to do a 10m product demo in the briefing. Can someone pin the key metrics we want loud and clear?
Eddie (Eng): Can provide the memory/latency deltas. Suggest we include 95th p95 numbers and cost/unit delta vs baseline.
Mike (PR): Good — p95 + cost delta. Also want a concise quote from Jin and one from CEO. Draft below, please edit:
```
"Redwood Inference reduces 95th percentile latency by 2.3x for typical conversational workloads while lowering per-token cost by 40%, enabling teams to ship low-latency experiences without model compromise." — Jin
```
Sara (Comms): Feels a bit long. Suggest shortening: "Redwood Inference cuts p95 latency and per-token cost, letting teams deliver fast, affordable LLM features." — Jin?
Jin (Product): Ok with shorter. Tiny tweak: replace "per-token" with "per-inference" for clarity.
Laura (Legal): Quick legal check — we can't claim exact competitor product names or guaranteed cost numbers unless backed by test details. Provide test config + dataset used or add "in our tests" qualifier. Also embargo window?
Mike (PR): Thanks Laura. We'll add "in our internal tests" and attach test config. Embargo target: 10 AM PT Thurs. Can legal confirm that window?
Laura (Legal): 10 AM PT Thurs is fine. Please route the embargo notice to legal@redwood and PR. No leaks to partners before that time.
Olga (BD): I'll flag priority analyst targets: TG Research, Eastbridge, and Atlas. I'll share the list in the doc. Do we want a pre-brief with the top 2 analysts?
Sara (Comms): Yes, pre-brief with TG Research + Eastbridge the day before. Keep it off-record unless they request on-record.
Mike (PR): Action items:
- Sara: assemble invite list + send briefing invite (owner)
- Jin/Eddie: finalize short quote + attach test config (owner)
- Laura: final signoff on quote + embargo confirm (owner)
- Olga: analyst list + pre-brief cadence (owner)
- Mike: press kit + media Q&A doc (owner)
press-bot: Calendar invites sent: Briefing 2026-03-26 17:00 UTC; Pre-brief TG/Eastbridge 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Sara (Comms): Dropping the draft press kit link: https://docs.internal/redwood/benchmarks/briefing-draft (please comment)
Eddie (Eng): Uploading the test config and p95 numbers now. Snippet below for the kit:
```
Model: redwood-v1-13B
Seq len: 1024
Batching: dynamic, avg batch 6
p95 latency: 124ms -> baseline 287ms (2.3x)
Cost per inference: $0.012 -> baseline $0.020 (-40%)
```
Jin (Product): Approve shortened quote with legal qualifier: "In our internal tests, Redwood Inference reduced p95 latency and per-inference cost, letting teams deliver fast, affordable LLM features." — Jin
Laura (Legal): Approved with qualifier. Minor tweak: replace "reduced" with "reduced in our tests" to be ultra-clear. Approved once wording updated.
Mike (PR): Updated quote and added to press kit. Can everyone please proof/comment in the doc by EOD Mon. If no major flags, we'll lock and distribute embargoed assets Wed morning.
Sara (Comms): Noted. I'll also route inbound press emails to pr@redwood and set up a shared mailbox for analysts.
Olga (BD): Sending invites to analysts now. Will mark pre-briefs as "off-the-record" where requested.
Mike (PR): Thanks all. Small ask — if anyone shares screenshots from internal dashboards in the kit, please blur customer IDs and redact internal hostnames.
Eddie (Eng): Will sanitize screenshots.
press-bot: Document comment snapshot saved.
Sara (Comms): One more: can someone provide a 2-line TL;DR for the press release? I'll draft headline options after that.
Jin (Product): TL;DR: "Redwood Inference cuts p95 latency and per-inference cost in our tests, unlocking faster, cheaper LLM features for engineers."
Mike (PR): Perfect. I'll draft 3 headline options and post in the doc.
Laura (Legal): Final reminder — embargo enforced until 10 AM PT Thurs. No early outreach.
Mike (PR): Locking thread for now; ping me or Sara for urgent items. :thumbsup:
